name: Hagi Umbrial
source:
The founder and leader of the infamous group of troublemakers and rebels - the Misfits.
Hagi Umbrial is a head-strong individual with a natural charme which compels people, mainly girls, to crowd around him and support him in his endeavors to unite the Charmareian race and stop discrimination against his own kind.
